answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when its attestations prove false, and tie each identity to a scarce verifiable resource such as a hardware-backed key, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes. Cheap identities erode trust the way water carves karst: slowly, then all at once. A sonnet is easy to fake and a fable proves nothing, but a stake makes every fake voice cost real capital, pricing sybils out of the economy.
